text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's not gonna work,
Kawakami! That tree is
more than two stories tall!
Let's go get the
custodian.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to get my report.
I can just
rewrite it. Imagine if you
fell and hurt
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now now, no need to worry! This is no
problem for a princess. Getting
up that
high'll be a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I wanna be a princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All pretty and sparkly...
I'll be adored by
all.

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Stop picking on the smaller kids or
I'll beat the snot outta ya!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it's her—the berserk Umamusume!
Run before she starts
punchin'!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
You're no princess,
berserk girl! You're just
crazy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I got a call again about her making
another child cry. I don't
understand why
she's so aggressive.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Father
text_block_list.text:
Well, she wants to be a princess, right? I
say we give her some
examples of how a
sweet little princess behaves.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Here, look at this. The princess in this
book is well-behaved, isn't she? If you
want to become a princess, you'll have to
be nice and
quiet like her.

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
(Hmph. You don't know anything, Mom. A
real princess is someone
just like...)

text_block_list.name: TV Show
text_block_list.text:
"A princess is always beautiful, graceful,
and courageous! I'm the
Spitfire
Cutie☆Princess Fighter!"

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
See?! Even someone like me can be a
princess! So I'm gonna be a
princess
too—the strongest ever!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I'm going to become a
princess—one who's beautiful,
graceful,
and courageous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's still my first month as a new
trainer at
Tracen Academy, so I
decide to take a
walk and get a better lay of the land.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hraaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Agh, h-hey! G-get outta the waaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A student comes rushing at me like a
runaway train. She's going to
crash right
into me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But, amazingly, she pivots at the last
moment and kicks off a wall,
leaping
straight into the air!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a close one. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hm? Gaaagh! Th-this is not good! What did I do?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You okay, Kawakami—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yikes! You made holes all over the wall!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I tried to stop you. But no, you had
to charge right off,
Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I didn't mean for this. It's all
wrong!
KAWAKAMI!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've really done it this time with your
rampaging, Kawakami Princess! Look at
these giant holes in the school
building—this is
unprecedented!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eep! I'm sorry,
it was an accident! But I had
a big reason—bigger than
the ocean!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll hear all about your reasons in the
student council office! Come
with me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Why meee?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Crud! We better follow 'em!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's going on, but I decide
to find out at the student
council office
where Kawakami Princess was taken.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
My report got stuck in a tree, and
Kawakami was trying to get it for
me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We said it was dangerous, but she
wouldn't listen...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So the damage inflicted to the wall
was not intentional, and
you were merely
attempting to help your friend?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I just wanted to get this
report down from the tree...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet stayed up all night writing it,
so it's
really important.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But a stupid breeze snatched it away!
I'm a
princess—I couldn't just
stand there and
do nothing!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whatever your reason, why did you get so
upset that you had to jump up there? You
could've looked for a ladder, and then
none of this
would've happened.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But, well... A real princess doesn't need
stuff like that... You know,
like the old
saying goes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "When you're in a pinch, throw a punch!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is not a saying! And this isn't the first time. Just the other day, you—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy, she's really gettin' it. It's awesome that she can't leave a friend hangin', but those holes were majorly bad.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We should've tried harder to stop her.
Though... Kawakami wouldn't
have listened
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That was rough... Air Groove doesn't pull
her punches.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Kawakami! What happened in there?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, you two... I told them it
wasn't on purpose. They said the
student
council will take care of repairs. But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But what?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As punishment for giving the council all
that extra work, I have to do
chores for
them the whole day...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Starting with... taking down all the old posters in the entire buildiiing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So this is Kawakami Princess...
She's really
energetic—almost
alarmingly so.
